description_en: Deletes snapshots of a simple application server
description_zh: 删除一个或多个已创建的快照
name: DeleteSnapshots

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application server. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The snapshot IDs. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 snapshot IDs. Separate multiple snapshot IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 快照ID。取值可以由多个快照ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: snapshot_ids

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The value of ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
